name: Implicit Volumetric Rendering for RNR-Map
definition: A rendering technique used in the RNR-Map decoder to compute pixel colors by integrating occupancy and appearance along rays, modified from GSN to render individual pixels efficiently without upsampling.
summary: Implicit Volumetric Rendering for RNR-Map efficiently renders individual pixels for navigation by using a neural decoder to map latent features to optical properties, avoiding the upsampling required by its parent GSN method.
